domain_claim: flush_batch returns Err(JournalError::JournalBatchBytesExceeded { attempted, limit }) before any owned_batch.commit() when the next staged event would push accumulated bytes above the configured limit
model_boundary: JournalWriterQueue::flush_batch + pure gate_decision predicate (no Fjall, no MutexGuard in the predicate)
notes: Atomicity anchor. The gate fires AFTER staged_keys_unique + durable_key_unique and BEFORE owned_batch.insert and owned_batch.commit(). On rejection, the OwnedWriteBatch is dropped without commit; pending.len() unchanged. Required Kani harness ps010::check_gate_fires_before_commit; unit tests flush_batch_rejects_oversize_no_commit and flush_batch_at_capacity_partial_drain_then_oversize_rejected_no_commit.

domain_claim: byte accounting basis is the full encoded record length (encode_record output), matching JournalWriteBatch::append_event and the existing parity test accounting_uses_full_encoded_length_not_payload_length
model_boundary: stage_queued_event + encode_record; gate input is value.len() (encoded record), NOT event.payload_len()
notes: Parity basis anchor. The encoded value has length 60 (RECORD_HEADER_BYTES) + postcard-encoded payload length. Both direct and queued paths consume the same value.len(). Required Kani ps010::check_basis_is_encoded_length and parity test asserting identical (attempted, limit) for the same event on both paths.

domain_claim: accumulated_bytes + next_event_bytes uses u64::checked_add; overflow returns Err(JournalBatchBytesExceeded { attempted: u64::MAX, limit })
model_boundary: gate_decision pure predicate; checked_add on u64
notes: Overflow contract anchor. Mirrors JournalWriteBatch::append_event:89-96. Required Kani ps010::check_checked_add_overflow_rejected with kani::any() for accumulator and next; unit test with synthetic accumulator near u64::MAX.

domain_claim: No new error variant; reuse JournalError::JournalBatchBytesExceeded { attempted: u64, limit: u64 } with diagnostic code 0x4022
model_boundary: JournalError enum + error/codes.rs diagnostic code table
notes: Single-variant anchor. Parity test asserts both paths emit the same (variant, attempted, limit, code, symbol). Negative test: assert no QueuedBatchBytesExceeded variant exists in JournalError.

domain_claim: StorageLimits::DEFAULT.max_journal_batch_bytes == DEFAULT_JOURNAL_BATCH_BYTES_INCLUSIVE_OF_HEADER (1_048_636) and the latter equals DEFAULT_JOURNAL_BATCH_BYTE_LIMIT + RECORD_HEADER_BYTES
notes: Default compatibility anchor. Enforced at compile time via const _STORAGE_LIMITS_DEFAULT_BATCH_BYTES_BOUND block. Kani bridge ps007::check_default_batch_byte_limit is preserved; new constant DEFAULT_JOURNAL_BATCH_BYTES_INCLUSIVE_OF_HEADER is added and tied via const assert.

domain_claim: byte accumulator is a stack-local u64 inside flush_batch; never a field on JournalWriterQueueState
notes: Concurrency anchor. Code review must confirm no field added to JournalWriterQueueState. Optional Kani model of mutex interaction confirms no shared mutable state. Loom model is out of scope (see open question).

domain_claim: byte gate fires AFTER staged_keys_unique guard; existing test flush_batch_rejects_same_batch_duplicate_key continues to pass
notes: Guard-precedence anchor. Existing test must pass unmodified. New test flush_batch_duplicate_key_takes_precedence_over_byte_gate verifies that when both gates would reject, DuplicateStagedKey is the surface error.

domain_claim: enqueue_journaled and enqueue_strict do NOT enforce the byte budget; only flush_batch does
notes: Negative-space anchor. Required unit test enqueue_does_not_enforce_byte_budget_only_flush_does: enqueue many near-max events that would together exceed the budget, observe all enqueues succeed, observe flush_batch rejects.

domain_claim: each queued event is encoded exactly once per flush; no double-encoding across drain_all iterations
model_boundary: flush_batch inner loop + drain_all iteration bound
notes: Performance anchor. drain_all iterates flush_batch up to ceil(capacity/batch_size)+2 times; the byte size of each event is computed inside flush_batch, so an event at the head of the queue is re-encoded at most once per flush. Micro-bench flush_batch_throughput_at_default_limit compares to a hypothetical Option-B implementation (stored byte size) as a sanity check; not a hard SLA.

domain_claim: flush_batch accepts exact-fit byte budget (attempted == limit)
notes: Comparison direction anchor. Strict > comparison (not >=) matches JournalWriteBatch:98. Required Kani ps010::check_exact_fit_accepted and unit test flush_batch_accepts_exact_fit_byte_budget.

domain_claim: drain_all short-circuits on the first JournalBatchBytesExceeded; no further flush_batch iterations attempted
notes: Composition anchor. Required unit test drain_all_short_circuits_on_first_byte_budget_rejection: enqueue events exceeding budget, call drain_all, observe Err and pending unchanged.

domain_claim: JournalWriteBatch::append_event and JournalWriterQueue::flush_batch emit identical error variant, diagnostic code, symbolic code, and (attempted, limit) shape for the same oversize event
model_boundary: both writer paths side-by-side in one test
notes: Parity-test anchor. MANDATORY test journal_write_batch_and_journal_writer_queue_emit_identical_error_for_same_oversize_event in crates/vb_storage/src/queue/tests.rs. Asserts (variant == JournalBatchBytesExceeded) AND (attempted == direct.attempted) AND (limit == direct.limit) AND (code == 0x4022) AND (symbol == JOURNAL_BATCH_BYTES_EXCEEDED).

domain_claim: EncodedRecordLength and AccumulatedFlushBytes newtypes prevent payload-basis vs encoded-basis confusion at the gate
model_boundary: gate_decision pure predicate + newtype smart constructors
notes: Type-system anchor. Required unit tests flush_batch_rejects_zero_byte_event (EncodedRecordLength::new(0) returns Err) and proptest with kani::any()-style symbolic event sizes bounded by MAX_ENCODED_RECORD_BYTES.

domain_claim: Misleading comment in workspace_tests/tests/journal_batch_accounting_tests.rs:48-51 claiming JournalWriteBatch does not enforce byte limits is corrected
notes: Doc-correction anchor. The existing comment contradicts crates/vb_storage/src/batch/append_event.rs:86-102; must be rewritten to state that JournalWriteBatch enforces byte limits at append_event time and JournalWriterQueue enforces at flush_batch time.

domain_claim: flush_batch accepts a single max-size encoded event (1_048_636 bytes) against the default budget (1_048_636)
notes: Default-fit anchor. Required unit test flush_batch_accepts_single_max_size_event enqueues one max-payload event and flushes; observes Ok(report{1,1}). Mirrors existing kani_vb_vzcuf_ps007::check_bridge_accommodates_single_event for the queued path.
